market_analysis.market_type_reason: The market is B2B because the primary buyers are commercial buildings, industrial facilities, institutions, and governments requiring regulatory-compliant fire protection and emergency systems.
market_analysis.market_definition: The life safety industry encompasses the manufacturing, integration, and servicing of systems designed to protect building occupants during emergencies, including fire alarms, suppression systems, and emergency lighting.
market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer was chosen because the competitive landscape of this industry analysis is structurally anchored by the companies that engineer and produce the certified physical equipment, whereas integrators and service providers act as downstream delivery channels.
